findings.reason: The parallel list 'Load, process, and save' is broken: the third item is turned into a different grammatical structure, making the sentence read as a garbled enumeration.
'Talent casting' is rendered as 탤런트 캐스팅 in the title but 인재 캐스팅 here; the same term should be consistent across the page.
Transliterated 'image-to-image'/'image-to-video' here conflicts with the descriptive form 이미지에서 이미지로 / 이미지에서 비디오로 used in the extended description; inconsistent phrasing across the entry.
'Reference' must be rendered as 참조 per the required UI terminology; 참고 is a deviation.
Workflow group label 'STEP 2' is kept in English everywhere else (extendedDescription, howToUse) but localized to 2단계 here, breaking consistency with the on-canvas label.
'Identity' is translated as 정체성 in the extended description and FAQ but transliterated as 아이덴티티 here; inconsistent within the entry.
English says 'if available' (whether the images exist), not 'if needed'; slight meaning shift.

The workflow name is transliterated in the title but kept in English in the extended description ('Hairstyle Changer는...') and howToUse ('Hairstyle Changer 워크플로'), and rendered descriptively in the description ('헤어스타일 변경 워크플로'). Three different renderings of the same workflow name across one page.
'selfie' is rendered 셀피 in the description, metaDescription and howToUse, but 셀카 here — inconsistent terminology within the same page.
'가상으로' (virtually) is added; the English 'Try haircuts and colors on your selfie' contains no such qualifier.
